meta.note: ANAC says that without prior authorisation you may fly only up to 43 m within 5 km of a runway threshold, and not in a runway approach or climb path. This circle is 5 km from the centre of every airport in the open data, so it is only a guide, and it marks where the 43 m limit applies, not a ban. Control zones are also closed to the open category; the AIP shows the real airspace.
